public_rationale: On July 29, 2026, Microsoft forecast year-over-year capital expenditure growth for FY2027, ending June 30, 2027 [e1]. This interim guidance does not establish a completed investment cycle, the companies' post-cycle financial condition, or whether unsustainable OpenAI and Anthropic spending predominantly inflated revenue expectations [e1].
limitations: The packet does not establish that the cycle had ended by October 28, 2026 or supply comparable pre-cycle and post-cycle financial records for Microsoft, Google and Amazon.
The dependence of revenue expectations on unsustainable OpenAI and Anthropic spending is unmeasured.
The source specifies no precise baseline, accounting basis or numerical deterioration threshold. Meta's tentative inclusion is not independently assessed.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: At the end of this hype cycle, Microsoft, Google and Amazon, and tentatively Meta, will be in a much worse condition than before, with revenue expectations overwhelmingly inflated by two unsustainable companies.
public_payload.original_horizon_text: At the end of this hype cycle

statement.excerpt: At the end of this hype cycle, Microsoft, Google and Amazon (and, I guess, Meta) will have left themselves in a much-worse condition than before, with revenue expectations that are overwhelmingly inflated by two unsustainable companies.

from_speaker: At the end of this hype cycle
revenue expectations that are overwhelmingly inflated by two unsustainable companies
our_interpretation: The core prediction concerns Microsoft, Alphabet's Google business, and Amazon. Meta is a tentative extension.
The ordinary reading of worse condition is materially weaker financial resilience and earning capacity, assessed using cash generation, debt, asset impairments, and sustainable earnings together.
Before means before the AI investment cycle, not automatically the publication date. The source supplies no precise baseline date.
The two companies are OpenAI and Anthropic. The forecast requires evidence that their unsustainable spending predominantly inflated the relevant revenue expectations.
The end of the hype cycle is an event-based horizon without a calendar deadline. A temporary market decline or one weak quarter does not establish that endpoint.
criteria.support_condition: After an independently documented unwinding of the AI investment cycle, comparable financial records show material deterioration at the three core companies, alongside evidence that unsustainable OpenAI and Anthropic spending predominantly inflated the relevant revenue expectations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented completed cycle and comparable financial records show the core companies did not materially deteriorate, or that the relevant revenue expectations were predominantly supported by sustainable demand. Divergent company results would warrant a partial assessment.
